data.title: Chat: watcher-deploy-real.test.js should fail fast, not hang 10 min, when the first evaluate() is not a deploy decision

data.to: From the AS-87 cycle-1 review (qa-priya, 2026-09-11, N2). The opt-in real-build test in apps/chat/test/watcher-deploy-real.test.js enters a 'while (!ops.isDeploying())' spin after the first evaluate(); when that evaluate() refuses (no docker, inputs dirty, no git in the container) nothing exits the spin, so the failure mode is a 10-minute hang instead of a fail. Observed as AS-87 M8's container 'red' — a hang, not a failing assertion. FIX: assert the first decision's action === 'deploy' (naming the actual reason in the message) before entering the spin. FALSIFIER: run the test where docker is absent and expect a fail within seconds, not a timeout. May be closed by AS-87's rework cycle 1 if the implementer takes it there — check the AS-87 branch before starting.

data.body: Folded into the AS-87 cycle-1 rework (developer-marcus, commit ddc8833 on feat/AS-87-deploy-heartbeat-and-log): the opt-in real-build test now asserts action === 'deploy' before the isDeploying spin, and a refused first evaluate() fails in 0.73 s instead of hanging. This task closes as folded when AS-87 merges; if AS-87's review rejects that hunk it reopens as its own work.

Folded into AS-87 (merged b3c9ce2): the real-build test now asserts action==='deploy' before the isDeploying spin and fails in ~0.7 s on a refused first evaluate() — Priya proved it on two refusal shapes (no-git, AS-84 error belt) in cycle 2.
